method: Original inference-event counts reused from retained Oct3 inventory; paths checked present. Later development directory associations and bounded textual mentions are conservative indicators, not paid-run counts or proof of no exposure. Repeated directories distinguish repeated active attention from original benchmark exposure. Broad prior exposure inventory excluded from mention scans. Alias/path scans can miss names; no never-exposed or held-out assertion. Source-screening for this preparation adds development exposure to selected cases.
